description: deixis-set-v1 conformance vectors, slot-member form — the finite-set container by self-keying of docs/design/0005-set-keys.md. Hand-authored from the spec, not generated by an implementation. Two member encoders (vectors/README.md): `bytes` (members are byte strings, e = identity, leaves spelled as hex) and `class` (members are the fixture setoid, e = the UTF-8 bytes of `class`, representation deliberately ignored). Construction feeds members in authored order; expected nodes are compared by node identity, never textually. Refusal reasons are the ratified slot-member set: mis_keyed, struct_member, leaf_node — the non-canonical-member refusal is node-member-only and deliberately absent here. Judgments are append-only except an explicit erratum.

cases.name: form-boundary-keys
cases.note: Self-keying under e = id: every key equals its member's bytes, including the empty member at the empty key and a prefix pair as distinct entries.

cases.name: form-empty-set
cases.note: The empty set is Struct(∅) — a valid set node with nothing in it.

cases.name: form-class-members
cases.note: Keys are e(member) = the class bytes; representations ride along in the leaves and never touch a key.

cases.name: idempotence-by-construction
cases.note: Inserting a member twice spells the same key twice; the floor refuses the duplicate. The tree cannot express the second insert.

cases.name: idempotence-under-coarse-equality
cases.note: ≈-equal members with different representations spell one key — idempotence is decided by e, never by native equality of the carriers.

cases.name: membership-boundary-encodings
cases.note: Membership is key membership: one lookup at e(q), exact octets — prefixes and the empty string are distinct members.

cases.name: membership-is-by-class
cases.note: A query with a never-seen representation is IN if its class encodes to a present key; a shared representation with an absent class is OUT.

cases.name: recognize-coherent
cases.note: Every child a leaf, every key equal to its member's bytes — in the image.

cases.name: recognize-empty-set
cases.note: Struct(∅) is the empty set; there is nothing to be incoherent.

cases.name: recognize-mis-keyed
cases.note: Key 61 spells class 'a' but the member's class is 'b' — refused, never re-keyed.

cases.name: recognize-struct-member
cases.note: Slot members are leaves; a struct child sits outside the form's image.

cases.name: recognize-leaf-node
cases.note: A set node is a struct; a bare leaf is well-formed deixis and simply not a set.

cases.name: identity-across-entry-orders-and-representatives
cases.note: Authored order differs and every representative differs; set equality reduces to node identity under the lifted ≈, and both dimensions vanish.

cases.name: identity-distinguishes-members
cases.note: {01} and {01 00} are different sets: different domains, exactly.
